scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The map polygon covers 1492 to 1500 in the eastern Peruvian Amazon and is not verified as a contemporary boundary. It does not establish a state, common founding date or extinction. Narrative examples primarily concern particular Peruvian communities, not every Amahuaca settlement.

The Ministry’s suggestion connecting ancestral lake accounts with Imiría archaeology is not treated as an established ethnic identification. No ancient settlement is declared Amahuaca solely from this proposed connection. Conflicting or differently defined population and speaker totals are not repeated.

Dole’s Economy entry is read as a historical ethnographic account. Claims about all communities, universal contemporary clothing, annual movement and absence of art are not adopted. The three passages derived from this entry stay within a single source budget; split website subpages are not treated as independent works.

The Smithsonian finding aid was read in indexed text at page 2703. The exact house image is inventory 04325900, not adjacent inventory 04325800. The colonial coffee-plantation setting matters; a catalog cultural attribution is not a verified precolonial archaeological context. The original photograph was not independently viewed.

Clem’s 2018 examples explain grammar and are not evidence that the elicited actions occurred as historical events. The 2025 corpus is explicitly based on translated sentences reviewed by speakers, not an unprompted oral-history collection. No current speaker count or universal claim that children no longer learn the language is adopted.

Hewlett’s first-person report dates the inauguration to 26 November 2015 during a three-day gathering. The card describes the project and documented activities, not an unverified promise that every proposed future exhibit or tourist income was realized.

The 2024 Inuma report is direct interviewing and observation, used for biography, garden work and transmission of knowledge. Medical efficacy claims and preparation instructions are omitted. Unrelated spam links appended to the webpage are disregarded.

The 2016 decree is used as a historical document, not current legal advice or verification that every protection is effectively enforced. Its different categories for different peoples and for initial contact are preserved. No sensitive settlement coordinates are reproduced.
Independent historical review, border assessment and depth certification remain pending.
